cases.prompt: Correct a typo in an ordinary README paragraph.
cases.rationale: The target is not an always-read repository instruction file.

cases.prompt: Rename one local variable and run its focused unit test.
cases.rationale: The task has no long-session, broad-read, or context-budget risk.

cases.prompt: Review this one pull request and summarize whether its focused tests cover the change.
cases.rationale: A single local review has no user-designated director role or multi-task project outcome.

cases.prompt: Summarize the current status of these tasks without directing or changing their work.
cases.rationale: A read-only status summary does not designate this session as an active project director.

cases.prompt: Use a few parallel subagents to inspect these independent files, then combine their findings in this task.
cases.rationale: Ordinary bounded delegation does not designate a persistent director session or shared multi-task project charter.

cases.prompt: Reduce the horizontal padding on this existing button by four pixels.
cases.rationale: The request is a settled local style edit rather than a new screen or major redesign.

cases.prompt: Review this finished landing page for AI-looking visual patterns without changing it.
cases.rationale: The request is a post-hoc read-only review, not interface creation or a major redesign.

cases.prompt: Fix a pure synchronous formatter that returns the wrong punctuation.
cases.rationale: No asynchronous freshness, intent, or presentation-state boundary is involved.

cases.prompt: Explain what this single function does in one response.
cases.rationale: A one-shot read-only explanation does not need durable task state.

cases.prompt: Start a new project-context task in a repository that has no scattered legacy notes.
cases.rationale: New task creation is not a migration from existing context.

cases.prompt: Apply the already-approved one-word copy correction.
cases.rationale: The direction is settled and the change is mechanical.

cases.prompt: Adjust spacing in one component without changing state or domain meaning.
cases.rationale: No user or domain meaning crosses representation boundaries.

cases.prompt: Implement the change using the API contract already confirmed as authoritative.
cases.rationale: Source ownership is already proven and the task has moved to implementation.

cases.prompt: Mechanically update one generated version value with no logic change.
cases.rationale: The edit is purely mechanical and does not justify structural intervention.

cases.prompt: Change this existing predicate from archived OR disabled to archived AND disabled; the function already owns the rule and its focused tests.
cases.rationale: The existing unit supports a coherent local change and focused verification without structural judgment.

cases.prompt: Add an optional label to this existing serializer mapping and its focused test; the serializer already owns this field mapping.
cases.rationale: Being feature work alone does not trigger the skill when one focused unit already owns and verifies the change.

cases.prompt: Create a new architecture specification from an unresolved product idea.
cases.rationale: New specification design is not final cleanup of a selected document package.

cases.prompt: Design and build a new operations dashboard, deciding its primary task, page hierarchy, states, and responsive layout.
cases.rationale: A new dashboard with unsettled page-level decisions belongs to broader interface design.

cases.prompt: Change this button padding from 12px to the already-approved 8px value.
cases.rationale: An exact approved mechanical edit requires no interface-quality judgment.
